title: %std — population standard deviation
purpose: Compute the population standard deviation of a numeric array.
notes: Divides the summed squared deviations by n (population), not n−1.
Identical values have zero spread, so the result is 0.
Provide the array as a typed array block ({returns[] : ~}); a scalar argument yields ~ (null).

avoid.why: passing a scalar instead of an array yields ~ (null); %std needs a numeric array
